CIRCLE TIME 1 · AGE 2

Hello School! Circle Time

Age 2 YearsClass Circle Time 1Duration 5–8 minutes

A whole circle time in one little class — the hello, the moving, the listening, a tiny story and the goodbye, just like a morning at preschool. Everything happens on one screen, one moment at a time, and the last activity sends you both off the rug and into the real world.

Read the prompts aloud and do them together. Your toddler does not need to read — every word on the screen is for you.

Start Circle Time ↓Find a comfy spot on the floor and sit together.

“Hi! Come sit with me. Ready?”

— Your Kiddo School teacher

👏👏👋

Clap, clap, wave!

Can you copy me?

Touch your head.

Clap your hands.

Stomp your feet.

Reach up high.

Listen & Do

“Listen carefully. Can you do it?”

Wave!

Point up!

Clap!

Touch your toes!

FACES TOGETHER

Let’s make some faces.

Make a happy face!

Make a silly face!

Show me sleepy.

Give me a big smile!

TINY STORY

Story Time

A little child packed a school bag.

They came to school.

The teacher waved. “Hello!”

The child waved back. It was time to learn and play.

Part 1 of 4

Off the Rug

“Can you find your favorite book?”

“Go get it and bring it back!”

Take your time.

“Great! You brought a book.”

GOODBYE

“That was fun. See you next time!”

FAMILY FEEDBACK

How was this activity?

Your feedback helps us make Kiddo School better. This is feedback about the activity, for the grown-ups who make it — it is never about a child.

Comments stay short and are read by the school office before they appear. Don’t include private information — no surnames, ages or addresses.
